//! What the schemas of the memory names adapter accept and refuse.

use super::schemas::{StoredNameSchemaError, StoredNameSchema};
use crate::cases::{Case, Expect, Word, run};
use crate::outbound::names::types::Asked;

type Input = StoredNameSchema;
type Value = Asked;
type Failure = StoredNameSchemaError;

/// The rows of the stored names the schemas accept and refuse.
const CASES: &[Case<Input, Value, Failure>] = &[
    Case {
        name: "a stored name becomes the name asked for",
        word: Word::Succeeds,
        input: || StoredNameSchema { text: "Ada" },
        expect: Expect::Value(Asked("Ada")),
    },
    Case {
        name: "an empty stored name is refused",
        word: Word::Refuses,
        input: || StoredNameSchema { text: "" },
        expect: Expect::Error(StoredNameSchemaError::Empty),
    },
];

/// Converts one stored name through the schemas.
fn subject(stored: Input) -> Result<Value, Failure> {
    Asked::try_from(stored)
}

#[test]
fn succeeds() {
    run(CASES, Word::Succeeds, subject);
}

#[test]
fn refuses() {
    run(CASES, Word::Refuses, subject);
}
